verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              केशवस्य तु तद्वाक्यं कर्णः श्रुत्वाऽऽहितः शुभम्। अब्रवीदभिसंपूज्य कृष्णं तं मधुसूदनम् ॥१॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said Hearing these beneficial and auspicious words of Keshava, Karna said after duly worshipping that slayer of Madhu.

verses.sanskrit: जानन् मां किं महाबाहो संमोहयितु‌मिच्छसि। योऽयं पृथिव्याः कार्त्स्न्येन विनाशः समुपस्थितः ॥२॥
verses.english: Knowing everything why do you wish to confound me and lead me to folly? You know that the destruction of the entire world is at hand.
verses.bhavadeepa: केशवस्येति । शुभं राज्यादिलाभं आहितः प्रवेशितः प्रलोभित इत्यर्थः ॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: निमित्तं तत्र शकुनिरहं दुःशासनस्तथा। दुर्योधनश्च नृपतिर्धृतराष्ट्रसुतोऽभवत् ॥३॥
verses.english: The cause of this are Shakuni, myself and Dushasana and also Duryodhana the son of Dhritarashtra, the ruler of men,

verses.sanskrit: असंशयमिदं कृष्ण महद्युद्धमुपस्थितम्। पाण्डवानां कुरूणां च घोरं रुधिरकर्दमम् ॥४॥
verses.english: Without doubt, O Krishna, a great calamity is at hand, the blood of the Pandavas and the Kurus will be the fierce clay.

verses.sanskrit: राजानो राजपुत्राश्च दुर्योधनवशानुगाः। रणे शस्त्राग्निना दग्धाः प्राप्स्यन्ति यमसादनम् ॥५॥
verses.english: The kings and princes, following the leadership of Duryodhana, consumed by the fire of weapons in the battle, will go to the abode of Yama, the king of death.

verses.sanskrit: स्वप्ना हि बहवो घोरा दृश्यन्ते मधुसूदन। निमित्तानि च घोराणि तथोत्पाताः सुदारुणाः ॥६॥
verses.english: Many fierce dreams are dreamt, O slayer of Madhu, as also are seen fierce omens and very great disturbances.

verses.sanskrit: पराजयं धार्तराष्ट्रे विजयं च युधिष्ठिरे। शंसन्त इव वार्ष्णेय विविधा रोमहर्षणाः ॥७॥
verses.english: Events occur which make the hair stand on end which, O you scion of the Vrishni race, portend defeat to the son of Dhritarashtra and victory of Yudhishthira.

verses.sanskrit: प्राजापत्यं हि नक्षत्रं ग्रहस्तीक्ष्णो महाद्युतिः। शनैश्चरः पीडयति पीडयन् प्राणिनोऽधिकम् ॥८॥
verses.english: That active planet of great effulgence Shanaishchara (Saturn) troubles the star Prajapatya indicating greater troubles to living creatures.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा चाङ्गारको वक्रं ज्येष्ठायां मधुसूदन। अनुराधां प्रार्थयते मैत्रं सङ्गमयन्निव ॥९॥
verses.english: The planet Angaraka travels obliquely to the constellation Jyeshtha, O Slayer of Madhu, and goes towards Anuradha as if seeking its friendship.
verses.bhavadeepa: प्राजापत्यं रोहिणीनक्षत्रं प्रजानां पतिर्दुर्योधनस्तदीयं नाम नक्षत्रम् उत्तराभाद्रपदाख्यमिति वा । तेन पत्युः पीडया प्राणिनामपि पीडेति युक्तम् । यद्वा पृथ्वीकूर्मोदरस्थां रोहिणीं शनैश्चरः पीडयति तेन मध्यदेशे महान् क्षयो राज्ञो नाशश्चेति भावः ॥८॥

verses.sanskrit: नूनं महद्भयं कृष्ण कुरूणां समुपस्थितम्। विशेषेण हि वार्ष्णेय चित्रां पीडयते ग्रहः ॥१०॥
verses.english: Surely, O Krishna, a great calamity for the Kurus at hand especially as the planets go against Chitra.
verses.bhavadeepa: कृत्वा चेति । ज्येष्ठामप्राप्य यदि भौमो वक्री भवेत्तर्हि ज्येष्टस्य राज्ञो येऽमित्रभूतास्ते सर्वे नश्येयुरिति भावः । मैत्रं मित्रसमूहं संगमयन् नाशयन् । वैवस्वतं संगमनं जनानामित्यादौ संपूर्वस्य गमेर्मारणार्थत्वदर्शनात् ॥९॥

verses.sanskrit: सोमस्य लक्ष्म व्यावृत्तं राहुरर्कमुपैति च। दिवश्चोल्काः पतन्त्येताः सनिर्घाताः सकम्पनाः ॥११॥
verses.english: Rahu comes to the sun which has covered the path of the moon and from the heavens fall down meteors with loud noise and making the earth shake.
verses.bhavadeepa: चित्रां ग्रहो महापाताख्यो ज्योतिःशास्त्रप्रसिद्धः । तेन राकारस्य वेधाद्राजजातीयानां क्षयो भवितेति भावः ॥१०॥

verses.sanskrit: निष्टनन्ति च मातङ्गा मुञ्चन्त्यश्रूणि वाजिनः। पानीयं यवसं चापि नाभिनन्दन्ति माधव ॥१२॥
verses.english: Elephants are making terrific yells and horses are shedding tears and do not take delight in food and drink, Madhava.

verses.sanskrit: प्रादुर्भूतेषु चैतेषु भयमाहुरुपस्थितम्। निमित्तेषु महाबाहो दारुणं प्राणिनाशनम् ॥१३॥
verses.english: When such omens prevail, it is said, that a great calamity is at hand causing, O you of long arms, a very great massacre of living beings.

verses.sanskrit: अल्पे भुक्ते पुरीषं च प्रभूतमिह दृश्यते। वाजिनां वारणानां च मनुष्याणां च केशव ॥१४॥
verses.english: Though taking but little food, it is seen that the evacuations of horses, of horses elephants and men are very great in quantity, OKeshava.

verses.sanskrit: धार्तराष्ट्रस्य सैन्येषु सर्वेषु मधुसूदन। पराभवस्य तल्लिङ्गमिति प्राहुर्मनीषिणः ॥१५॥
verses.english: The wise have said, O Slayer of Madhu, that these are signs of the defeat of the entire army of the soon of Dhritarashtra.

verses.sanskrit: प्रहृष्टं वाहनं कृष्ण पाण्डवानां प्रचक्षते। प्रदक्षिणा मृगाश्चैव तत्तेषां जयलक्षणम् ॥१६॥
verses.english: The army, of the sons of Pandu how ever are seen to be cheerful; the deer go to their right and that is a sign of their victory.

verses.sanskrit: अपसव्या मृगाः सर्वे धार्तराष्ट्रस्य केशव। वाचश्चाप्यशरीरिण्यस्तत् पराभवलक्षणम् ॥१७॥
verses.english: But all the animals go to the left of Duryodhana's army, O Keshava, and there are also unearthly voices heard which are the signs of defeat.

verses.sanskrit: मयूराः पुण्यशकुना हंस-सारस-चातकाः। जीवञ्जीवकसङ्घाश्चाप्यनुगच्छन्ति पाण्डवान् ॥१८॥
verses.english: Auspicious birds such as peacocks, swans, Sarasas, Chatakas and groups of Jivajivas and cranes follow the Pandavas.

verses.sanskrit: गृध्राः कङ्का बकाः श्येना यातुधानास्तथा वृकाः। मक्षिकाणां च सङ्घाता अनुधावन्ति कौरवान् ॥१९॥
verses.english: Vultures, Kankas, Bakas hawks and birds of prey, Yatudhanas and wolves, and bees follow the Kauravas.
verses.bhavadeepa: लक्ष्म व्यावृत्तं क्षीणत्वादमावास्यासान्निध्यात् क्षीणचन्द्रोऽपि पाप एव । तस्मिंश्चामावास्यायामर्केण युक्ते उभयोः शत्रुः सदा वक्री राहुरर्कम् उपैति चेदयं कर्तरीयोगः । सोमवंश्यानां सूर्यवंश्यानां च राज्ञां क्षयकर इत्यर्थः । पुण्यशकुना हंसादय एव । पाठान्तरे पुण्यशकुनाः कुक्कुटाः जीवंजीवकाः पक्षिविशेषाः । ये जीवजीवेत्येवशब्दं कुर्वन्ति तेषां संघाश्चकोरादयः ॥१८॥

verses.sanskrit: धार्तराष्ट्रस्य सैन्येषु भेरीणां नास्ति निःस्वनः। अनाहताः पाण्डवानां नदन्ति पटहाः किल ॥२०॥
verses.english: In the army of the son of Dhritarashtra, no sound comes from the drums while those of the Pandavas give forth sounds when even not struck.

verses.sanskrit: उदपानाश्च नर्दन्ति यथा गोवृषभास्तथा। धार्तराष्ट्रस्य सैन्येषु तत् पराभवलक्षणम् ॥२१॥
verses.english: Reservoirs of waters produce sounds similar to those of cows and bulls; that is a sign of defeat to the army of the son of Dhritarashtra.

verses.sanskrit: मांसशोणितवर्षं च वृष्टं देवेन माधव। तथा गन्धर्वनगरं भानुमत्समुपस्थितम् ॥२२॥
verses.english: Down pours of flesh and blood are poured by the gods, O Madhava, and the city of Gandharvas appears shining like the sun in the sky,

verses.sanskrit: सप्राकारं सपरिखं सवप्रं चारुतोरणम्। कृष्णश्च परिघस्तत्र भानुमावृत्य तिष्ठति ॥२३॥
verses.english: With walls, with trenches, with beautiful porticoes and pillars dirty in the sky is seen to surround the sun.

verses.sanskrit: उदयास्तमने सन्ध्ये वेदयन्ती महद्भयम्। शिवा च वाशते घोरं तत् पराभवलक्षणम् ॥२४॥
verses.english: At the conjunction of day and night namely when the sun rises and sets are seen terrific sights; the jackals tertific howls and these are the signs of a defeat.
verses.bhavadeepa: गन्धर्वनगरं सप्राकारं परिधः परिवेषः तत्राकाशे गन्धर्वनगरोपर्येव ॥२३॥

verses.sanskrit: एकपक्षाक्षिचरणाः पक्षिणो मधुसूदन। उत्सृजन्ति महद्घोरं तत् पराभवलक्षणम् ॥२५॥
verses.english: Birds, having but one wing, or one eye or one leg, O slayer of Madhu, make terrific shrieks and these are the signs of a defeat.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णग्रीवाश्च शकुना रक्तपादा भयानकाः। सन्ध्यामभिमुखा यान्ति तत् पराभवलक्षणम् ॥२६॥
verses.english: Birds, with black neck read feet, which are terrible looking, go towards the army, in the evening and these are the signs of a defeat.
verses.bhavadeepa: एकपक्षाक्षिचरणाः पक्षिणो महाराष्ट्रभाषायां ‘पांकोळी’ इति प्रसिद्धाः । घोरं बीभत्सं मलमूत्रादिकमित्यर्थः ॥२५॥

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणान् प्रथमं द्वेष्टि गुरूंश्च मधुसूदन। भृत्यान् भक्तिमतश्चापि तत् पराभवलक्षणम् ॥२७॥
verses.english: First he treats the Brahmanas with contempt and his elders, O slayer of Madhu, and then his servants who are attached to him and these are the signs if a defeat.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वा दिग्लोहिताकारा शस्त्रवर्णा च दक्षिणा। आमपात्रप्रतीकाशा पश्चिमा मधुसूदन। उत्तरा शङ्खवर्णाभा दिशां वर्णा उदाहृताः ॥२८॥
verses.english: The eastern direction looks red and the southern is the colour of weapons while the western looks the earth, O slayer of Madhu. North looks like the conch. These are the colours of all directions.

verses.sanskrit: प्रदीप्ताश्च दिशः सर्वा धार्तराष्ट्रस्य माधव। महद्भयं वेदयन्ति तस्मिन्नुत्पातदर्शने ॥२९॥
verses.english: All the directions the encampment of the son of Dhritarashtra are ablaze as if in conflagration, O Madhava and the sight of these disturbances presages a great calamity.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रपादं प्रासादं स्वप्नान्ते स्म युधिष्ठिरः। अधिरोहन्मया दृष्टः सह भ्रातृभिरच्युत ॥३०॥
verses.english: In a dream dreamt by me, O Achyuta, I saw Yudhishthira in company with his brothers ascending a palace having a thousand pillars.

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतोष्णीषाश्च दृश्यन्ते सर्वे वै शुक्लवाससः। आसनानि च शुभ्राणि सर्वेषामुपलक्षये ॥३१॥
verses.english: They appeared to me all with white headdresses and white garments and Saw all of them on white seats.

verses.sanskrit: तव चापि मया कृष्ण स्वप्नान्ते रुधिराविला। अन्त्रेण पृथिवी दृष्टा परिक्षिप्ता जनार्दन ॥३२॥
verses.english: You, O Krishna, were seen by me in that ocean throwing weapons on the earth which was covered with blood, O Janardana.

verses.sanskrit: अस्थिसञ्चयमारूढश्चामितौजा युधिष्ठिरः। सुवर्णपात्र्यां संहृष्टो भुक्तवान् घृतपायसम् ॥३३॥
verses.english: Yudhishthira, of immeasurable energy, having ascended a heap of human bones, was cheerfully eating payas (rice boiled in milk and sugar) mixed clarified butter out of a golden vessel.
verses.bhavadeepa: तव पृथिवीति सम्बन्धः त्वच्छरीरमित्यर्थः । परिक्षिप्ता परिवेष्टिता ॥३२॥

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिरो मया दृष्टो ग्रसमानो वसुन्धराम्। त्वया दत्तामिमां व्यक्तं भोक्ष्यते स वसुन्धराम् ॥३४॥
verses.english: Yudhishthira was seen by me to be swallowing this earth and this indicates that he will enjoy this earth given by you.

verses.sanskrit: उच्चं पर्वतमारूढो भीमकर्मा वृकोदरः। गदापाणिर्नरव्याघ्रो ग्रसन्निव महीमिमाम् ॥३५॥
verses.english: Vrikodara, of terrible actions, having ascended a high mountain, that best among men, mace in hand, stood as if swallowing this earth.

verses.sanskrit: क्षपयिष्यति नः सर्वान् स सुव्यक्तं महारणे। विदितं मे हृषीकेश यतो धर्मस्ततो जयः ॥३६॥
verses.english: This plainly indicates that in the great battle he will kill all of us. It is known to me, O Hrishikesha, that where there is virtue there is victory.

verses.sanskrit: पाण्डुरं गजमारूढो गाण्डीवी स धनञ्जयः। त्वया सार्धं हृषीकेश श्रिया परमया ज्वलन् ॥३७॥
verses.english: Dhananjaya, that wielder of the Gandiva with you, O Hrishikesha, shining with great effulgence.

verses.sanskrit: यूयं सर्वे वधिष्यध्वं तत्र मे नास्ति संशयः। पार्थिवान् समरे कृष्ण दुर्योधनपुरोगमान् ॥३८॥
verses.english: You will all slay the rulers of the earth having at their head Duryodhana in the battle-I have doubt as to that.

verses.sanskrit: नकुलः सहदेवश्च सात्यकिश्च महारथः। शुक्लकेयूरकण्ठत्राः शुक्लमाल्यांबरावृताः ॥३९॥
verses.english: Nakula and Sahadeva and the great carwarrior Satyaki, decked with white ornaments and putting on white garlands and white garments,

verses.sanskrit: अधिरूढा नरव्याघ्रा नरवाहनमुत्तमम्। त्रय एते मया दृष्टाः पाण्डुरच्छत्रवाससः ॥४०॥
verses.english: These best among men ascending a vehicle by human beings which had nothing better than it, were seen by me with a white umbrella over their heads and with white robes on. were
verses.bhavadeepa: शुक्लानि मौक्तिकमयत्वात् केयूराणि बाहुभूषणानि कण्ठत्राणि कण्ठपुरकाख्यानि शिरोदेशमारभ्य अंसपर्यन्तं लम्बमानानि कण्ठाभरणानि येषां ते शुक्लकेयूरकण्ठत्राः ॥३९॥

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतोष्णीषाश्च दृश्यन्ते त्रय एते जनार्दन। धार्तराष्ट्रेषु सैन्येषु तान् विजानीहि केशव ॥४१॥
verses.english: These there were seen also with white head gears the army of the son of Dhritarashtra; know their, names, O Keshava.

verses.sanskrit: अश्वत्थामा कृपश्चैव कृतवर्मा च सात्वतः। रक्तोष्णीषाश्च दृश्यन्ते सर्वे माधव पार्थिवाः॥४२॥
verses.english: they Ashvathama, Kripa and Kritavarman of the Satvata race; all other king of the earth were seen with blood coloured dresses, O Madhava.

verses.sanskrit: उष्ट्रप्रयुक्तमारूढौ भीष्मद्रोणौ महारथौ। मया सार्धं महाबाहो धार्तराष्ट्रेण वा विभो॥४३॥
verses.english: Ascending camels the ten great carwarriors, Bhishma and Drona along with myself, O you of arms, and also with the son of Dhritarashtra, O lord,

verses.sanskrit: अगस्त्यशास्तां च दिशं प्रयाताः स्म जनार्दन। अचिरेणैव कालेन प्राप्स्यामो यमसादनम् ॥४४॥
verses.english: Were going towards the direction ruled by Agastya, O Janardana, and in a short time we reached the abode of Yama.

verses.sanskrit: अहं चान्ये च राजानो यच्च तत् क्षत्रमण्डलम्। गाण्डीवाग्निं प्रवेक्ष्याम इति मे नास्ति संशयः ॥४५॥
verses.english: Myself and all those other kings making this assembly of Kshatriyas shall enter the Gandiva fire-in this I have no doubt.

verses.sanskrit:
कृष्ण उवाच।
              उपस्थितविनाशेयं नूनमद्य वसुन्धरा। यथा हि मे वचः कर्ण नोपैति हृदयं तव ॥४६॥
verses.english: Krishna said This world will truly come to an end, since my words, O Karna, do not seem acceptable to you.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषां तात भूतानां विनाशे प्रत्युपस्थिते। अनयो नयसङ्काशो हृदयान्नापसर्पति ॥४७॥
verses.english: When the destruction of all creatures, my dear friend, is at hand, that which/is wrong is not removed from the heart, having the appearance of right.
verses.bhavadeepa: तव हृदयं कर्तृ मम वचो नोपैति नाङ्गीकरोति ॥४६॥

verses.sanskrit:
कर्ण उवाच।
              अपि त्वां कृष्ण पश्याम जीवन्तोऽस्मान्महारणात्। समुत्तीर्णा महाबाहो वीरक्षत्रविनाशनात् ॥४८॥
verses.english: Karna said If I am alive, O Krishna, I shall see you after this great battle, destructive of Kshatriya heroes, which is come on us, O you of long arms.

verses.sanskrit: अथवा सङ्गमः कृष्ण स्वर्गे नो भविता ध्रुवम्। तत्रेदानीं समेष्यामः पुनः सार्धं त्वयाऽनघ ॥४९॥
verses.english: Else there will be a meeting between us surely in heaven. I now see that I shall meet you there only, O sinless one.

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              इत्युक्त्वा माधवं कर्णः परिष्वज्य च पीडितम्। विसर्जितः केशवेन रथोपस्थादवातरत् ॥५०॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said Saying this Karna, having having closely embraced Krishna, and been dismissed by Keshava, dismounted from the chariot.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स्वरथमास्थाय जाम्बूनदविभूषितम्। सहास्माभिर्निववृते राधेयो दीनमानसः ॥५१॥
verses.english: Then having seated himself on his own car bedecked with gold he returned in company with his own followers, with a sad heart.
verses.bhavadeepa: पीडितं यथा स्यात्तथा गाढं परिष्वज्येत्यर्थः ॥५०॥ इतिकरणे - कर्णोपनिवादः कर्णस्य भेदनम्।

verses.sanskrit: ततः शीघ्रतरं प्रायात् केशवः सहसात्यकिः। पुनरुच्चारयन् वाणीं याहि याहीति सारथिम् ॥५२॥
verses.english: Then did Keshava along with Satyaki proceed with greater speed saying again and again to his driver "go-go”.
